title: From IceCube to IT-Sphere: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical GNN for Banking IT Root Cause Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.22822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Hybrid Quantum Root Cause Analysis (HQ-RCA), an industrially grounded workflow for root cause analysis in banking IT operations, built on a hybrid Quantum Graph Neural Network (QGNN): the classical backbone of DynEdge (the IceCube neutrino-reconstruction GNN, which we call standalone DynEdge), with its classification head replaced by a Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC). On 13 months of anonymised IT data (13k alarm clusters) from a major European bank, the hybrid QGNN matches standalone DynEdge -- the strongest classical baseline -- on $F_1$, while standalone DynEdge leads the ranking metrics. A readout-sensitivity and layout-robustness study, analysed via Dimensional Expressivity Analysis (DEA), shows that the effective parameter dimensionality (rank) of the quantum observable has no measurable correlation with $F_1$; we therefore keep the simplest readout $\langle Z_0\rangle$ (the Pauli-$Z$ expectation on the first qubit),

translated_title: 从IceCube到IT领域：用于银行IT根因分析的混合量子-经典图神经网络
translated_abstract: 我们提出了混合量子根因分析（HQ-RCA），这是一个面向银行IT运维根因分析的工业级工作流程，构建于混合量子图神经网络（QGNN）之上：采用DynEdge（IceCube中微子重建GNN，我们称之为独立DynEdge）的经典骨干网络，并将其分类头替换为变分量子电路（VQC）。在来自一家欧洲大型银行的13个月匿名IT数据（1.3万个告警聚类）上，混合QGNN在F1分数上与最强的经典基线——独立DynEdge——持平，而独立DynEdge在排序指标上领先。通过维度表达能力分析（DEA）进行的读出敏感性与布局鲁棒性研究表明，量子可观测量的有效参数维度（秩）与F1分数之间没有可测量的相关性；因此我们保留了最简单的读出⟨Z₀⟩（即第一个量子比特上的泡利-Z期望值）。
tldr: 该论文将IceCube中微子重建GNN DynEdge的经典骨干与变分量子电路结合，构建混合量子图神经网络用于银行IT根因分析，在真实银行数据上达到与最强经典基线相当的F1分数，并通过维度表达能力分析发现量子可观测量的有效维度与性能无相关性，从而选用最简单的读出方式。
en_tdlr: This paper combines the classical backbone of the IceCube neutrino-reconstruction GNN DynEdge with a Variational Quantum Circuit to build a hybrid quantum GNN for banking IT root cause analysis, achieving F1 scores matching the strongest classical baseline on real bank data, and showing via Dimensional Expressivity Analysis that the effective dimensionality of the quantum observable has no correlation with performance, justifying the simplest readout choice.
